question: By whose agency and will did the yoginī named Icchā extend up to māyā?
premises: The action reaches up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, extended up to māyā.
uncertainties: The verbal action governing māyāntaṃ is implicit.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, reached up to māyā.
